description:
We can’t dance, but we can measure. Two Left Feet is a Medellín team taking on Dancing with the SARs, and the name is a fair description of both us and the instrument: NISAR carries two radars, both look left, and what they leave on the ground is a footprint.

The team is led by a civil and environmental engineer with 25 years in consultancy, where remote sensing and geospatial analysis are everyday working tools. That experience is paired with a strong background in AI, ML and AI Agents.
